data_description.contacts: While one of them is open, closed shutters move to their vent position.

room_positions.title: Vent position in {room}
room_positions.description:
How far each shutter opens for ventilation, in percent (0 = closed, 100 = fully open). When a window opens, only shutters below this position go up. When the window closes they return to their previous position, unless someone moved them in the meantime.
